mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate level compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% signals economic weakness that triggers equity market sell-offs due to reduced corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand contraction that depresses corporate profit outlooks, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through correlated weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 900 and RSAFS < 400,000, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth in late-cycle expansion regimes signals robust economic activity that supports elevated equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of late-cycle expansion instances, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 900 thousand units signal weak residential demand that correlates with broader economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 900, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals the implementation of zero interest rate policy, which stimulates equity valuations through lower discount rates and increased liquidity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market characterized by high employment growth and low unemployment rate supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through correlated labor market strength.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth is high and UNRATE is low, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During zero interest rate policy regimes, the Federal Reserve's commitment to ultra-low rates and potential quantitative easing supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of zero interest rate policy instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
